label: VALIDATION_COUNTRY_FOUND
definition: A Validation Test, applied to a SingleRecord, that evaluates: Does the value of dwc:country occur in the bdqval:sourceAuthority? It returns: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:country is bdqval:Empty; COMPLIANT if value of dwc:country is a place type equivalent to administrative entity of "nation" in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT. It uses the following default authority and/or parameter values: The Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names (TGN). Its behavior can be altered by the following parameter(s): bdqval:sourceAuthority.
description: Does the value of dwc:country occur in the bdqval:sourceAuthority?
notes: Non-country information such as "high seas" will fail this Test (high seas should use dwc:countryCode = "XZ" and have dwc:country empty). Getty Place Types for administrative level "nation" are 81010 nation, 81011 independent sovereign nation, and 81012 independent nation. Multiple values in the dwc:country field (whether to signify on a border or in a list of possibilities) will fail this Test. Locations outside of a jurisdiction covered by a country code should not have a value in the field dwc:countryCode. This Test should find any matches at the Getty "nation" level including internationalized names and historical representations of that nation (where boundaries are same). This Test must return NOT_COMPLIANT if there is leading or trailing whitespace or there are leading or trailing non-printing characters.
expectedResponse: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:country is bdqval:Empty; COMPLIANT if value of dwc:country is a place type equivalent to administrative entity of "nation" in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT
authoritiesDefaults: bdqval:sourceAuthority default = "The Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names (TGN)" {[https://www.getty.edu/research/tools/vocabularies/tgn/index.html]}
examples: [dwc:country="Eswatini": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:country is a valid country name in the bdqval:sourceAuthority"],[dwc:country="Tasmania": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=NOT_COMPLIANT, Response.comment="Tasmania is not found at the level of national in the bdqval:sourceAuthority"]
references:
• Getty Research Institute (2017) Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names Online. https://www.getty.edu/research/tools/vocabularies/tgn/index.html
  • Chapman AD and Wieczorek JR (2020) Georeferencing Best Practices. Copenhagen: GBIF Secretariat. https://doi.org/10.15468/doc-gg7h-s853

label: MULTIRECORD_MEASURE_QA_COUNTRY_FOUND
prefLabel: Measurement over MultiRecord for QualityAssurance of Validation dwc:country Found
definition: A Measure, applied to a MultiRecord, that evaluates for quality assurance: Measure if all VALIDATION_COUNTRY_FOUND in a record set are COMPLIANT. It returns: COMPLETE if every VALIDATION_COUNTRY_FOUND in the MultiRecord has Response.result=COMPLIANT; otherwise NOT_COMPLETE. It is based on the aggregated outcomes of the Test(s): VALIDATION_COUNTRY_FOUND.
description: Measure if all VALIDATION_COUNTRY_FOUND in a record set are COMPLIANT.
notes: For Quality Assurance, filter record set until this measure is COMPLETE.
expectedResponse: COMPLETE if every VALIDATION_COUNTRY_FOUND in the MultiRecord has Response.result=COMPLIANT; otherwise NOT_COMPLETE.
